_comment: MEASURED ON A BOX, 2026-09-21 (DIVE-4794, wavy-mesa + poke-two), CORRECTED 2026-09-27 (DIVE-4998), and the halves are NOT symmetric — read the next three paragraphs before editing either marker. THE POSITIVE MARKER IS THE HALF WHOSE FAILURE LIES, and it lied: the first one, `class="[^"]*chatlist`, matched 9 times on the settled live session and 0 on the 2026-09-21 logged-out render, but by 2026-09-25 the K app's SIGNED-OUT render carries `class="tabs-tab chatlist-container sidebar …"`, and `[^"]*chatlist` matches the `chatlist` inside `chatlist-container`. So a signed-out profile probed `authenticated` on the first poll and every acting verb ran on a dead session. THE MARKER NOW ASKS FOR THE WORD `chatlist` AS A WHOLE CLASS NAME — `class="([^"]* )?chatlist[ "]`, i.e. at the start of the attribute or after a space, and followed by a space or the closing quote. Measured on the 2026-09-25 renders: 0 on both signed-out renders, the cold render and the curl'd shell; 1 on the live signed-in render (`class="chatlist virtual-chatlist"`). Alternatives that also measured 0 signed-out and at least 1 signed-in, if this one drifts: `id=["']?folders-sidebar`, `id=["']?new-menu`, `id=["']?folders-tabs`. THE LOGGED-OUT MARKER IS HALF-MEASURED and deliberately so: it matched 0 on the live session (so it cannot false-alarm on a good login), but the K app never rendered its sign-in page inside the probe's window on a fresh profile — 0 matches for every sign-in string — so 'it matches a logged-out page' is UNVERIFIED. That gap is safe here only because of DIVE-4794's second half: with a logged_in marker present, a page that shows neither marker is UNKNOWN and every acting verb stays refused, so the unmeasured direction asks a person instead of handing a caller a screenshot of a login form. DO NOT MARK ON THE SHELL: `has-auth-pages` on <body> and <div id="auth-pages"> ship in the STATIC index for both states — the app removes them after it decides it is logged in — and an adapter written against them is what stamped `expired` on a live session at 16:58Z and made every brokered verb refuse.

probe.logged_out_when_dom_matches: (page-signQR|auth-qr-form|Log in to Telegram by QR Code|LOG IN BY PHONE NUMBER)
